settings.a: Yes. Choose Klarna at checkout to split the cost into 3 interest free payments.
Pay in 3 is interest free. Klarna explains everything, including what happens if a payment is late, before you confirm.
Klarna is for UK residents over 18 and is subject to status. Klarna decides at checkout.

settings.q: How do I manage my payments?
settings.a: In the Klarna app or on the Klarna website. You can see what is due and pay early if you want to.

settings.q: I paid with Klarna. How do refunds work?
settings.a: Once we process your return, Klarna updates your payment plan and refunds anything you have already paid.
